verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a broad programmatic surface: SDKs for querying the API, Metrics API v2, a CLI for terminals and coding agents, an MCP server, scores via API/SDK, experiments via SDK and CI/CD, OTLP ingestion, and blob storage export. Nothing in the pack claims full UI/API parity, and several workflows (annotation queues, scores via UI, playground, editing prompts in the UI) are described only as UI features. A user also reports the trace retrieval API was too slow for bulk scanning and bypassed it by querying the database directly. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or a published, discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), documented API coverage for UI-centric features such as annotation queues, the playground and dashboards, and independent confirmation that the API performs adequately for bulk work.
